observations: Photo shows a boxed copier/printer unit on a table, wrapped in plastic.
Brand text on the box reads 'FRANCOSDETOIA' (appears printed on packaging).
No visible model number, no control panel, no ports, no toner/drum close-up, no power-on/copy sample.

claims.evidence: Photos only show a wrapped boxed unit; multifunctional capability and exact model are not readable.
Unit is sealed/wrapped; cleanliness cannot be confirmed from the photo.
No powered-on test page or sample print is shown.

risks.risk: Model/brand is not verifiable from the photo; pricing depends heavily on exact model and whether it’s copier vs printer vs MFP.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the unit’s nameplate/model label (usually on the side/back) or the control panel showing the model.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic multifunction copier/printer with unknown specs (worst-case: basic/older unit, no confirmed scanning/fax).

risks.risk: Functionality not proven (copy/scan/print/fax may be faulty).
risks.proof: A short video of power-on and a test copy/scan (show the output page).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not confirmed working (worst-case: needs service).

risks.risk: Consumables/toner/drum status unknown; may require immediate replacement.
risks.proof: Photo of toner level indicator (or inside cover) and drum/unit condition.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming toner/drum may be low/needs replacement.

risks.risk: Shipping/packaging damage risk since it’s boxed and wrapped; internal parts may be damaged.
risks.proof: Photos of the box for dents/tears and a close-up of any damage; plus a power-on test.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially damaged until tested.

risks.risk: Connectivity and paper handling unknown (ADF, duplex, tray capacity).
risks.proof: Photos of the ADF/duplex unit and paper trays; show paper feed working during test.
risks.if_unproven: Price as minimal configuration (worst-case: no duplex/limited trays).

proof_requests: Clear photo of the copier’s model/serial label (side/back nameplate) and the control panel.
Video of power-on and a test copy showing a printed page (sharpness/clarity).
Photos of toner level and drum/toner cartridge condition (inside cover).
Photo/video showing ADF/duplex features (if multifunction) and a scan test (if claimed).
Photos of the box condition (any dents/tears) and confirmation of included accessories (power cable, USB/network, manuals).
response.reason: The photo shows a boxed, wrapped unit with no readable model and no proof of copying quality or working status. Without a model label and a powered-on test page, the correct worst-case pricing can’t be set confidently.
